story.paragraph1: IBLM Law Group is established on the belief that legal practice is an integral part of legal development. With modern takes on the legal industries, IBLM Law Group focuses on 4 fields (groups): Entertainment/Creative Industry, Technology, Health & Education, and People & Labor.
story.paragraph2: We are currently led by partners with combined decades of experience in the legal industry. IBLM Law Group is committed to navigate the complexity of regulations while aiming to create effective industry focused solutions. By realizing the dynamic Indonesian legal landscape as well as the fast paced development of various industries globally, we strengthen our capabilities by collaborating with various legal experts. This enables us to leverage our perspective in delivering tailored legal solutions for our clients. Our mission is to stand as a trusted partner for businesses and individuals navigating complex regulatory regimes. Through collaboration and innovation, IBLM Law Group strives to provide tailored legal solutions that empower our clients to thrive in a rapidly evolving world.

probono.title: Guardians of the Underrepresented
probono.description: We believe access to justice is the bedrock of a fair society. Our Pro-Bono program provides elite legal counsel to those who shape communities but lack the resources to defend their vision.
probono.card1Desc: Legal protection and contract negotiation for small organizations and communities with limited capital.
probono.card2Desc: Strategic litigation support for non-profits focused on online privacy and user data sovereignty.
probono.card3Desc: Defending researchers and students facing legal threats for identifying industry vulnerabilities.
probono.card4Desc: Dedicated counsel for underrepresented founders entering the business and technology marketplace.
probono.calloutDesc: Eligibility is determined by financial standing and social impact. Typically reserved for entities with limited resources dedicated to community welfare.
